content.short: 10K unique & handmade Teddy Troops are preparing to march at their HQ.
content.description:
The Teddy Troops have been occupying the public space since 20 years. And now they are preparing to conquer the Metaverse in Q1-2022! 10K unique & handmade Teddy Troops are preparing to march at their HQ. Their mission has been told since years... Why collecting just random humans, animals or androids? When you can build up your powerful legion of Teddy Troops! Each single Teddy Trooper is strengthen your army.

Mint / Collect / Trade / Hold! Since more than 20 years now street- and graffiti-artist FLYING FÖRTRESS is on a „one-bear-army“ mission to send out his iconic TEDDY TROOPS to public space. He started in 2001 to bring his TEDDY TROOPS to life by using spray-paint, posters & stickers in the streets but also turning them into art via paintings and fine art prints. Soon he also transformed the TEDDY TROOPS into 3D art by released them as designer toys for the urban vinyl collectorsʼ world.

Traveling all over the globe for exhibitions, graffiti jams and art events he made the TEDDY TROOPS become a very well-known and beloved visual character to the people and collectors everywhere. Now for January 2022 he is preparing to drop 10K unique NFT TEDDY TROOPS to the digital art universe to make them conquer and occupy the Metaverse.
